common.offline: No connection. History and favorites work offline.

translate.title: Translate
translate.subtitle: Type a text — the translation appears by itself. For 1–3 words a full word card appears below: article, declension, examples.
translate.placeholder: Type a text in any language…
translate.emptyText: Type a word or a phrase on the left. The translation appears here in a moment.
translate.voiceDenied: The microphone could not be turned on. Allow access in the browser settings.
translate.voiceUnsupported: This browser does not support voice input.

others.title: How others translate it
others.autoHint: Variants from other translators — compare and pick the best one.
others.noAnswer: The service did not answer right now
others.empty: No other translators are connected yet.
others.error: The variants could not be loaded. Try again.
others.aiHint: AI translation on request, to save the free limit.
others.aiFailed: The AI did not answer right now. Please try again.

word.needAi: A full word card needs AI, and the free requests for today are used up. The translation above is ready.

check.title: German check
check.subtitle: Corrections with an explanation of every mistake

dictionary.title: Dictionary
dictionary.subtitle: Word cards, favorites and history — all stored on your device.
dictionary.favoritesEmpty: No favorites yet. Tap the star next to a translation.
dictionary.historyEmpty: The history is empty. Translate something on the “Translate” tab.

profile.title: Profile
profile.subtitle: App settings and AI access
profile.keysHint: The site keys have a daily limit. Your own free key removes it and stays on this device only.
profile.keySaved: The key is saved on the device
profile.privacy: Your keys stay yours: the server uses them only for the request. In your account the key is stored encrypted.
profile.limitsTextFree: Without signing in and without your own key the daily limit of the site keys applies. An account and your own free key remove it.
profile.privacyAccount: In the account the key is encrypted and never shown in full — only the last 4 characters.
profile.installText: Open the site in your phone browser and add it to the home screen — the translator then works like a normal app.
profile.installIos: On iPhone: “Share” → “Add to Home Screen”. On Android: menu ⋮ → “Install app”.
profile.showOthersHint: For texts up to 300 characters the “How others translate it” block appears right away. Longer texts — on the “Show” button.
profile.adminHint: You are the site administrator: statistics, keys and settings are available.

account.title: Account
account.intro: Sign in and your AI keys, favorites and history are the same on all your phones and computers.
account.sharedHint: One login works on several phones — you can even share it with your family.
account.registerHint: Login: 3–32 characters, Latin letters, digits, dot, hyphen or underscore. Password: at least 8 characters.
account.newPasswordHint: After the change other devices are signed out. This phone stays signed in.
account.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other devices have been signed out.

errors.invalidCredentials: Wrong login or password. Please check and try again.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait 15 minutes.
errors.loginTaken: This login is already taken. Choose another one or sign in with it.
errors.loginInvalid: Login: 3–32 characters, Latin letters, digits, dot, hyphen or underscore.
errors.passwordTooShort: The password must be at least 8 characters long.
errors.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Sign in again — favorites, history and keys are safe.
errors.keysStorageDisabled: Storing keys in the account is turned off right now. The key can be saved on this device.
errors.keyNoAccess: This key does not grant access. Make sure you copied all of it.
errors.blocked: This account has been blocked by the administrator.

keys.geminiStep1: Sign in with Google — any Google account works.
keys.geminiStep2: Click “Create API key” and copy the key.
keys.geminiStep3: Come back here: the field fills itself and the key is checked.
keys.groqStep1: Sign up or sign in to the Groq Console.
keys.groqStep2: Click “Create API Key” and copy the key.
keys.groqStep3: Come back here: the field fills itself and the key is checked.
keys.checkOk: The key works, answered in {{ms}} ms
keys.checkFailed: The key was not accepted. Make sure you copied all of it.
keys.accountHint: Sign in above in “Account” so the key works on all your devices.
keys.introAccount: Your own free key removes the daily limit. When you are signed in it is stored in the account and works on all your devices.
keys.introDevice: Your own free key removes the daily limit. Until you sign in it is stored on this device only.
keys.privacyAccount: The key is encrypted on the server and never shown in full — only the last 4 characters.
keys.privacyDevice: The key stays in this browser and goes to the server only in the request header.

services.title: Site services
services.intro: Which services are connected. The button below sends each of them a small real request — that is how you see whether a service answers.
services.cached: The result is fresh: the check runs at most every 10 minutes.

limit.title: Connect your own free key
limit.text: The free requests for today are used up. Your own key is free and needs no card.
limit.geminiStep3: Copy the key and paste it below
limit.groqStep3: Copy the key and paste it below
limit.keyFail: The key was not accepted. Make sure you copied all of it.
limit.privacyNote: The key is stored on your device only.

soon.learnText: Flashcards, exercises and streaks are the next step. Meanwhile take a look at the dictionary.
soon.conversationText: The two-person conversation mode comes later. Meanwhile practise translating and listening.

errors.validation: Please check the input and try again.

errors.server: A server error. Try again later.
errors.rate: Too many requests. Wait a couple of seconds.
errors.sameLanguage: The source and target languages are the same.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait 15 minutes and try again.
errors.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Sign in again — your data is safe.
errors.forbidden: Not enough rights: this page is only for administrators.

about.title: About
about.subtitle: Translator, dictionary and German tutor
about.description: YAi Translator translates between 12 languages, shows full word cards for German words, explains grammar and checks your sentences. It runs in the browser and installs on your phone.
about.freelyText: The site runs on free tiers only: Gemini and Groq keys are free and need no card.
about.sourcesText: The word card uses open dictionaries. Thanks to their authors:

admin.title: Admin
admin.subtitle: Statistics, site keys, settings and users
admin.denied: This page is only for administrators.
admin.deniedHint: Sign in with the account whose login is listed in the ADMIN_LOGINS secret.
admin.loadError: The data could not be loaded. Try again.

overview.visitorsHint: Unique visitors by a hash of the IP and the date. The IP itself is not stored.
overview.chartEmpty: Data appears after the first translations.

keys.title: Site keys
keys.intro: If one key runs out, the site takes the next one by itself. Cloudflare keys are read-only; keys added here are stored encrypted.
keys.storageDisabled: Storing keys is off: the server has no KEY_ENCRYPTION_SECRET secret. Keys cannot be added, Cloudflare keys are visible.
keys.laraHint: Lara: paste “id:secret” — both values from your Lara account.
keys.added: The key was added and checked.
keys.addFailed: The key was not saved: the service rejected it or it is incomplete.
keys.cloudflareHint: This key is set in Cloudflare (Settings → Variables and secrets) and can only be deleted or replaced there. New keys are easier to add here.

settings.title: Site settings
settings.limitLabel: Daily limit of free AI requests per IP
settings.limitHint: Default: {{value}}. Lower it if the AI services run out too fast.
settings.bannerHint: Shown to everyone at the top of the site. Visitors can close it with the cross.
settings.invalidLimit: The limit must be a number from 1 to 10 000.

users.title: Users
users.intro: Login, registration date, last sign-in, number of devices and own keys.
users.confirmRemove: Delete the account {{login}} together with favorites and keys? This cannot be undone.

switches.title: Translators: on / off
switches.hint: A switched-off service is not used anywhere on the site. MyMemory is off by default: anyone can write to its database, and sometimes it returns rubbish.
